title.narrative: Khartoum Emergency Response- Warm Winter project Kararri and Um Bada Localities

description.narrative:
This project is emergency response to the campaign initiated by the Sudan National Secretariat General of the voluntary work of the National Congress, Khartoum State. That has inaugurated the warm winter project at Karari and Um Bada locality, Khartoum State, that seeks to distribute winter cloths to families in a number of quarters. CAFOD in collaboration with national partner Mujaddidoun has on going education project in Khartoum state, the project targeted 12 schools in the two mentioned localities, Karri and Um Beda. The winter in Sudan this year is considered exceptionally cold and a threat to the well being of the kids and other vulnerable community members. Those two localities are considered by the Ministry of Education *(MoE) as 2 of the 4 most needy localities in Khartoum state. They are host to vulnerable communities of different types; IDPs, refugees and economically displaced people. CAFOD and Mujaddidoun respond to some of those problems with objective to increase enrolment, retention rate in these 12 schools, and to ensure quality basic education that can help in bettering future life. Project targets: Project will target 1,500 school children (boys and girls) of grades 1,2 and 3 for all the 12 schools currently being covered by CAFOD and Mujadiddun interventions.
Project objective: To support 1,500 boys and girls in need of warm clothes during the harsh winter months of December 15 to February 16.
Project activities' include: a) Rapid Assessment to verify the needy children b) Purchase of warm clothes for 1,500 school boys and girls in CAFOD and Mujadiddun target schools in Khartoum state. c) Purchase of blankets to 150 HH- 2 per HH for targeted families for boys and girls of the aforementioned schools d) Distribution of warm clothes to 1500 boys and girls of grade 1,2 and 3. e) Distribution of blankets to 150 vulnerable households around the target schools f) Post distributions Monitoring (PDM)
4. Project Monitoring:Post distributions monitoring will conduct after one month of distribution to monitor the aid to beneficiaries. CAFOD will coordinate response to warm winter needy in two mentioned localities by working together with national partners and all order government., Since the two targeted localities remain the poorest localities in Khartoum state and winter weather remains a threats to the safety of poor individuals and school children experiences poor shelters and needy for worm clothes.
